grammar.title: 语法知识 将来完成时
lines: 将来完成时 will / shall have + done By the end of next year ,they will have finishd work on the new stadium . 到将来某一点时间为止, 某个动作已经发生
现在完成时 have / has + done I have just received a letter from my brother, Tim . 到现在某一点时间为止过去完成式，到过去某一点时间为止
一般将来时
除了可以用来预言将来发生的事以外，还可以表示“意愿”，如允诺、建议、请求、提议等。
The radio hasn’t been mended yet. Never mind! I ’ll mend it for you. （允诺） Will you open the door for me please! （请求） Shall we go for a swim tomorrow? （建议）
将来进行时
除了表示最近或不久的将来正在进行的动作外，还可以表示计划或安排好的事。
A great many people will be visiting the country. Will you be spending your holidays abroad this year ?
将来完成时 常与by 和 not…till/until+表示时间的名词连用
用于表示到将来某一时刻已经完成的动作。
I hope they ’ll have finished it in time for the journey. I expect you will have changed your mind by tomorrow. I will have finished it until/till tomorrow.

sentences.title: 单词句型 完成时态总结
lines: 5 短语动词 look
过去完成时 had + done I had worked here for 10 days by last month.
现在完成时 have/has + done I have worked here for 25 days by now.
将来完成时 will have + done I will have worked here for 30 days by next week .
We are l ooking forward to celebrating the Spring Festival. 期待
Look out ! A bus is coming. 小心
I don't understand this word. I shall look it up in a dictionary. 查阅
Don't forget to look me up when you return. 拜访

expand.title: 扩展知识 Look 的短语
lines: 5 用 hold 或 look 的正确形式填空 每日习语 more of a hindrance than a help 更多的是阻碍而不是帮助(帮倒忙)
Look forward to (expect with pleasure) (高兴地)盼望，期待着 （to 为介词后面只能跟名词、代词和动名词，不能接动词原形 ） I am looking forward to the summer holidays. 我正盼望暑假的到来. I look forward to seeing to you during the weekend.
Look out (be careful) 当心 (注意)，留神 Look out ! A bus is coming. 当心点, 公共汽车来了. You should always look out when you walk across a road.
Look out of 朝外看 Don’t look out of the window .
Look up 看望、查阅 I don't understand this word. I shall look it up in a dictionary. (get information from a reference book) 查阅 (从参考书中获取资料)
Don't forget to look me up when you return. (visit) 拜访，看望 I’m going to look up Mary this afternoon.
The students' union held an interesting debate on capital punishment yesterday.
My friend Ingrid lives in Stockholm. Why don't you look her up when you're there?
Examinations will be held next week. I'm not looking forward to hold an exam them.
